Irie Smoothie: 3 Delicious Summer Smoothies
By: Justina Elumeze
Published: Sunday, May 29, 2016 - 8:53pm

Ingredients




Frozen watermelon, kale & strawberries.
Frozen bananas, pineapple, orange, mango & coconut.
Frozen bananas, pineapple, orange, mango & coconut.

Preparation

1 uice the ingredients seperately and then blend into the frozen bananas to create these organic, sweet, healthy, and fresh smoothies. 2 If using a NutriBullet (or similar) you can omit the juicing first and just blend everything together along with the frozen bananas.

About

These three smoothies are so delicious that I just had to give you all three recipes in one set. Refreshing, cool, sweet and healthy? Yes, these smoothies are all that, and then some.
